title: Undo is hidden with the movable editor and discarded by routine interactions
report: Undo is tied to input, can be offscreen during deletion, and moving accepts deletion, risking unintended permanent data loss. User proposes an animated Gmail-style Undo notification.
scope: Resolved 2026-11-04. User accepted the finished Undo bar and requested the final APK, ticket closure and commit. Original renderer migration remains DEV-011 history.

design_acceptance.accepted: Floating Undo bar with a full-height tinted background fill receding from right to left. Message, Font Awesome icon-only Undo action, outer shape and touch target stay fixed; use the preceding floating-bar slide/settle treatment and keyboard/safe-area placement.
design_acceptance.batch_policy: User selected: Restore the whole deletion batch; each deletion restarts 15 seconds.
design_acceptance.component_choice: User requested a separate file using Popup and ProgressBar; implemented as UndoBar.qml.
design_acceptance.whole_bar: User requested the whole bar to Undo through TapHandler, reusing TextIcon and the existing Font Awesome loader. No active, iconFontFamily or remaining properties.
design_acceptance.color: User final implementation accepted 2026-11-04: own ProgressBar background Rectangle uses Material.backgroundColor at opacity 0.2; accent fill, text and icon retain their full opacity.

reproduction: Use isolated data with a list longer than the viewport, enter edit mode and position/scroll the editor outside the visible rows.
Swipe a visible row right to delete it. Observe whether any reachable Undo action appears.
Within 15 seconds, scroll, press another row, move the editor or type/submit. Check whether deletion is still recoverable and whether the stored data can be restored.
Delete multiple rows in succession, then attempt recovery; establish the current loss of earlier commands and specify the intended batching policy.
expected: Recovery remains visible and reachable independently of the editor and scrolling. Routine navigation, typing and editor movement do not silently revoke it. Define safe behavior for further deletions and list mutations, with a clear countdown owned outside delegates.
design_proposal: Floating snackbar-like bar anchored to the visible view, above bottom safe area or native keyboard, keeping the editor and its draft intact.
Font Awesome curved Undo arrow as an icon-only action, at least the existing 9.27 mm touch target. A short notification can identify the removed entry/count; no text label inside the action.

Accepted visual treatment: brief upward slide/settle on entry; use the whole bar as the timer, with a theme-tinted background fill receding across its full height. Keep the message, Undo icon, outer bounds and touch target stationary. Scrolling must not dismiss the bar or restart its deadline.
Accepted policy: further deletions join the recovery batch and restart 15 seconds; Undo restores the whole batch.
Keep ownership and recovery logic KISS. The floating bar does not itself provide persistence across app termination; specify that separately if requested.
acceptance_criteria: Add a regression first: delete with the editor offscreen, then scroll/press/move the editor and still activate a visible Undo action. Confirm original behavior fails and the fix passes.

Check actual saved names, UUIDs, checked flags and ordering after Undo across successive deletions, insertions, pending edits, editor movement, reorder/check operations, and list switching according to the chosen policy.
Verify view-owned deadline delivery despite delegate recycling; check exact expiry, repeated deletion, activation near expiry, keyboard show/hide and background/resume policy.
Validate actual Android keyboard/safe-area placement and one-handed reachability using isolated data; scrolling must remain possible and the bar must not obscure the last reachable row.
Record policy decisions, failing-before/passing-after regression results and rendering/platform evidence before closure.
original_evidence: InputDelegate.qml owns the UndoIcon and its 15000 ms countdown through a Flipable, so recovery UI and timer lifetime are coupled to a movable/instantiated editor delegate.
ShopView.qml clears the Undo stack on TextDelegate.onPressed, ListView.onMovementStarted and the view-level TapHandler.onGrabChanged. InputDelegate submission also emits timeout, clearing Undo.
Model::remove saves the deletion immediately. clearUndoStack discards its recovery command; ordinary movement does not defer a database commit.
Model::remove clears an existing command before pushing the next deletion. Merely keeping the bar visible would not preserve a sequence of deleted items.

UndoRemove currently records numeric insertion positions. Safe recovery across subsequent editor movement, insertions, checks and reordering needs characterization; deleting the QML invalidation handlers alone is not a complete safe redesign.

tests/flows/tst_userflows.qml currently characterizes dismissal through test_other_interaction_dismisses_undo. Replace the obsolete policy assertion with a real failing-before regression when this ticket is selected.
implementation: Separate UndoBar.qml based on Controls.Popup with Controls.ProgressBar as its background, painting only the remaining opaque accent fill. Whole-surface TapHandler performs Undo; RowLayout/TextIcon reuse the existing Font Awesome loader through Popup.font.family. View owns visibility, placement, scroll margin and model hookups. Accessible Undo press action retained; native Popup transitions retained.
Removed editor Flipable/UndoIcon, delegate-owned deadline and routine-interaction invalidations. Undo keeps draft text/focus and native keyboard.

Existing QUndoStack merges UndoRemove commands into a batch. Each removed item retains UUID, surviving neighbor UUIDs and a fallback logical position; restoring does not submit a pending edit. Preserve surviving rows and newer changes.
Clock pauses with the drawer open or application inactive. Successful reload/list changes end recovery; failed loads preserve it. Process death ends this in-memory recovery.
Retired Canvas2D source/link dependency and old arc tests; Qt 6.12 minimum retained. APK deployment payload investigation remains separate under DEV-008.

clear_surface_trial.request: User selected Completely transparent for the area uncovered as the progress fill shrinks; fill, text and icon stay solid.
clear_surface_trial.implementation: Use Controls.ProgressBar as Popup.background, with no ProgressBar background. Only the remaining fill Rectangle paints pixels. Remove the color Binding and default Material surface/elevation shadow; keep the default Popup transitions and full-bar TapHandler.
clear_surface_trial.before: out/ui023/before-clear-surface.txt: four theme/scale cases fail against the previous surface-plus-shadow implementation. The revised test keeps production effects intact.
clear_surface_trial.after: out/ui023/clear-surface-rendering.txt: 8 native Windows records pass; uncovered pixels equal the known underlay exactly within raster tolerance, while filled pixels equal the opaque theme accent and message/glyph pixels retain their full color, at two widths/scales in Light/Dark. out/ui023/clear-surface-interactions.txt: 8 records pass. out/ui023/clear-surface-bulk-flows.txt: 5 records pass, including actual mouse and touch Undo after drawer bulk removal.
clear_surface_trial.earlier_trial: The 80%-surface trial was rejected by the user. Its color test disabled the Material shadow, missing the complete production appearance; that exception has been removed.
clear_surface_trial.limits: Historical completely-clear trial, superseded by the user-accepted separate 20%-opacity background Rectangle.

resolution.user_confirmation: Ok I think it's done. Create APK, close ticket and commit changes.
resolution.summary: View-owned reachable Undo with a full-bar TapHandler, accepted 20%-opacity background behind solid fill/text/icon, merged 15-second deletion batches and UUID/neighbor-based recovery preserving newer edits and drafts. Pause safely behind drawer/inactive app; warning-free idle animation and typed Application properties.
resolution.verification: Final Windows run: all five suites pass, 331 records; final isolated emulator run: 22 checks pass in both themes with no reported pause warning; lint, formatters, translation extraction and unchanged analyzed C++ baseline pass. ARM64 APK built and verified with the shared debug signing certificate.
